[[Jagged Antilles|Jagged]] and [[Zena Antilles]] owned and operated the '''Gus Treta fueling station''' on the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]]. It was destroyed in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] by [[Loka Hask]] of the [[Bonestar Pirates]].
